pitch.subject: A website idea for Copper Finch Painting
pitch.body:
Hi Copper Finch Painting team,

I came across your Instagram page while looking at painters in Glendale. I looked for a separate place to ask about an estimate and couldn’t find one.

I made a page that puts interior painting up front and gives people room to describe the job they have in mind.

Here’s the preview: https://p-19a220c6b4974f7801.sitescout-previews-ec8f1c9e.pages.dev

What would you change to make it feel more like your business?

Abraham
